about: One real Claude Code session of three turns, recorded through Botbench's driver by test/support/capture-plan.ts. Each turn was asked to reply with a given plan in the planner's reply format: turn 1 a plan with no tasks, turn 2 a plan whose task has no title and no criteria, turn 3 a plan of three tasks. The prompts are the capture's own, not Botbench's planner prompt.

turns.prompt:
Reply with exactly the following fenced block and nothing else, character for character:
```json
{"tasks":[]}
```

events.text:

```json
{"tasks":[]}
```

turns.prompt:
Reply with exactly the following fenced block and nothing else, character for character:
```json
{"tasks":[{"title":"","criteria":[]}]}
```

events.text:

```json
{"tasks":[{"title":"","criteria":[]}]}
```

turns.prompt:
Reply with exactly the following fenced block and nothing else, character for character:
```json
{"tasks":[{"title":"Add a greeting file","criteria":["hello.txt exists at the top of the repository","hello.txt holds the single line hi"]},{"title":"Add a farewell file","criteria":["bye.txt exists at the top of the repository"]},{"title":"Describe both files in the README","criteria":["README.md names hello.txt","README.md names bye.txt"]}]}
```
